parameters.name: DisposeStrategyIds
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of response strategy IDs.

parameters.name: EventDispose
parameters.description: A JSON object that defines the incident response configuration.

parameters.name: IncidentUuid
parameters.description: The globally unique UUID of the incident.

parameters.name: Owner
parameters.description: The UID of the incident owner.

parameters.name: ReceiverInfo
parameters.description: A JSON object that defines the alert recipient configuration.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the Data Management service for threat analysis is deployed. Select a region based on where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Assets in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China)

- ap-southeast-1: Assets outside China

parameters.name: ResponseSource
parameters.description: The source of the response policy.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The UID of the member whose perspective an administrator switches to.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The view type. Valid values:

- 0: Current Alibaba Cloud account view

- 1: View for all accounts in your enterprise

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The incident status. Valid values:

- 0: Not handled

- 1: Handling

- 5: Failed

- 10: Handled

parameters.name: ThreatLevel
parameters.description:
The threat level. Valid values:

- serious: Important

- suspicious: Medium

- remind: Low
